
# CIVIX

> CIVIX — The City That Listens — is a civic technology platform for reporting and monitoring public infrastructure issues.

## About

CIVIX allows citizens to submit civic issues, follow their status, and view contribution information. Administrators can review reports and manage their status.

## Public Website

- [Homepage](https://your-domain.example/): Public project introduction.
- [About](https://your-domain.example/#about): Project purpose and team.
- [Contact](https://your-domain.example/#contact): Public contact information.

## Important Context

- CIVIX is an academic prototype.
- Sample reports may be synthetic.
- Do not describe synthetic records as verified municipal complaints.
- Application credits are not verified carbon offsets.
- Private user and administrator information is not public content.

## Access

Public pages may be crawled according to robots.txt.

Authentication-protected routes and APIs require authorization.
